title: UFund-Me/Qbot
friendlyTitle: Qbot is an open toolkit for investment research
summary: Qbot is a local-deployment quantitative investment research platform with modules for data, backtesting, strategy research and trading experiments. The repository had about 18,600 stars when reviewed and was the third-strongest AI-related repository in today’s collected GitHub trend ranking.
friendlySummary: Qbot provides local tools for market data, strategy testing and quantitative trading experiments.
whyItMatters: It can serve as a learning and research environment for testing quantitative strategies without sending all work to a hosted platform. It is not evidence that a strategy will make money; use historical testing carefully and keep experiments separate from live funds.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to learn and test ideas, not as a promise of profit. Keep experiments away from real money until risks are understood.
